action.objective: Win the c6 pawn, then advance the passed c-pawn toward promotion while keeping the rook active.
action.rationale: b6c6 (Rxc6) is the sole commit_ready move: verified at depth 3 with exact score 224, no mate-in-one reply, and no tactical refutation found. It wins the c6 pawn and yields a dangerous passed pawn after c7. Black's likely Rxc5 or Rxe3 must be met by consolidation; evidence supports this as the strongest verified option.
